Turning no_test_restart off erases both casualties (Sanxion -19.9pp -> +0.2pp, One_on_One -37.0pp -> +0.5pp); --no-test-restart deletes the testbit frame, the only frame our conversions spend below $10, and siddump needs one below $10 to name an attack -- it OWNS frame 0 and a compensating row moves the boundary underneath it. It is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT -- four files carry both options happily, so the remaining question is the discriminator, which is rikky-immunity-to-regrid-is-unexplained
